name: kinesin family member 5B

function.text: KIF5B encodes kinesin-1 heavy chain. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and microtubule motor activity. It participates in centrosome localization and lysosome localization.

function.text: KIF5B encodes kinesin-1 heavy chain. Based in part on similarity, it can induce formation of neurite-like membrane protrusions in non-neuronal cells in a ZFYVE27-dependent manner. It regulates centrosome and nuclear positioning during mitotic entry. It is required for anterograde axonal transportation of MAPK8IP3/JIP3 which is essential for MAPK8IP3/JIP3 function in axon elongation.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving KIF5B have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, ALK-positive histiocytosis, and head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
